title: Mémento de l'assainissement
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: This Handbook is a methodological and practical guide for putting liquid sanitation services into operation in the Southern countries. It covers the entire wastewater and sludge collection and treatment chain in rural, semi-urban and urban contexts. Discover the website dedicated to this handbook: http://memento-assainissement.gret.org
